method: Exact fields: per context, the measured field strings of every case are hashed in Figma (FNV-1a of the sorted key=fields lines) and compared with the same strings built from computed.json; an equal hash proves each field equal, so observed repeats expected in its Figma form. Geometry: compared one by one with a tolerance. Body: authoring/adapters/figma/forms-parity.plugin.js; report: forms-parity-report.mjs.
